reading.action: Floor 2 (cleared): pocket the swarm-ichor, cross to the Sentry husk and search it for anything useful
reading.result: SOLID SUCCESS (margin 9). Pauldron auto-found (obvious); the small fire-purged rivet found via EMBER-SENSE (still-warm heat signature) despite weak observance (PER 11) — affinity bias +2 covered his eyes. Items acquired (both to inventory, NOT equipped/drawn): Sentry pauldron (armor def 2, wearable — first armor; carried, not worn) + fire-purged rivet (HEAT-affinity seed, SAME element as Ember — drawable like the cinder, resonant not opposite). Swarm-ichor confirmed pocketed/carried. AFFINITY heat sense-event NOTED but HELD — Ember Manipulation tick paused pending iris-prep per-point schedule; counter stays 1. No resource cost. Sunken 2nd iron bar + river-stone still in water, unlooted (not 'the body'). NO Tower reset.
